reachableSurface: Expo and Metro may inspect local image assets while bundling the mobile application. Ramassa does not call image-size directly and does not pass user-provided production data to it.
upstreamStatus: No patched image-size release exists as of 2026-08-24. The latest release is 2.0.2 and the upstream repository is archived.
removalCondition: Remove this exception when Expo or Metro no longer depends on image-size, or when a maintained compatible release or replacement includes both parser fixes.
